name: Ukor's Lost Pack

angles.text: As a young Horde adventurer in southern Durotar, you can help locals like Ukor by recovering belongings lost to dangerous wildlife.

faq.answer: Ukor lives in southern Durotar. When a huge spider confronted him in the wilds, he abandoned his belongings to escape.
Ukor dropped his pack while fleeing a huge spider in Durotar. He thought his belongings were gone for good until you found the bag.
faq.q: Why did Ukor lose his pack?

faq.answer: Take the recovered pack to Ukor in southern Durotar, where he waits to greet returning travelers.
faq.q: Where does the pack need to be taken?

faq.answer: Ukor's name is crudely stitched across the bag's flap.
A huge spider ambushed Ukor in southern Durotar. Terrified, he dropped his possessions and ran for safety.
faq.q: What kind of creature chased Ukor?

faq.answer: Ukor is astonished and deeply grateful to see his belongings again. He calls you a true hero for retrieving the bag.
faq.q: What happens when you return the pack to Ukor?

sections.body: In southern Durotar, you find a traveling bag with Ukor's name crudely stitched across its flap. In these harsh lands, discarded gear may point to trouble nearby.
sections.title: A Lost Belonging

sections.body: Ukor receives his pack in southern Durotar and tells how he lost it. A huge spider ambushed him, and he fled in panic, certain his supplies were gone. Finding the bag intact earns you Ukor's heartfelt gratitude and praise.
sections.title: Fleeing the Wilds

summary: In southern Durotar, Ukor's Lost Pack lies abandoned in the wilds. Its owner fled a huge spider and left his supplies behind.
